summary: 30 globally ranked Thanksgiving-weekend recommendations with expanded Tri-Cities and 70-mile-area live music, including Emerald of Siam, At Michele's, Rattlesnake Mountain Brewing, Sage Brewing, 3 Eyed Fish, Ray's Golden Lion, Brewminatti, Last Call, Gard Estate and Gesa Power House Theatre. Includes Toyota Center hockey. Local running and skiing/avalanche priorities preserved. The Ramon Ayala Toyota Center concert on Nov 28 is officially marked CANCELLED on Ticketmaster and excluded despite conflicting third-party ticket listings. Some cover charges, availability and precise point weather remain unconfirmed. No verified outdoor-adventure film this weekend.
